action.command: powershell -Command "$input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $input.tool_input.command; $blocked = @('push --force','push -f','reset --hard','clean -fd','push origin master','push origin main'); foreach ($b in $blocked) { if ($cmd -match [regex]::Escape($b)) { Write-Error \"BLOQUEADO: '$b' e uma operacao destrutiva. Use PR.\"; exit 2 } }; exit 0"
